self_critique.method: Same-agent self-critique against knowledge/taste-rubric.md's 6+1 axes (this arm is self-judged, no external model). Ran the four machine gates first, fixed every finding, rebuilt, re-ran gates to confirm clean, then read the rendered page at 1440px in a real browser (section by section) and checked color-contrast math by hand for every text/background pair before accepting.

machine_findings_fixed.finding: container-nesting-depth risk (caught during authoring, before first lint run) — hero's diagram card sat 3-4 purely-presentational <div> levels deep (section > hero-diagram-wrap > diagram-card > diagram-card-head) and the CTA band similarly nested a bare wrapper div 3 deep.
machine_findings_fixed.fix: Removed the redundant .hero-diagram-wrap wrapper (merged its positioning into .diagram-card directly) and marked the hero and CTA sections as their own CSS Grid track (.hero-grid, .cta-grid) so their direct children read as grid cells, not extra wrap layers. Net effect: one fewer DOM layer in the hero, and the CTA band's two columns no longer count as nested containers.

machine_findings_fixed.finding: a11y-lint heading-skip (WCAG 1.3.1), 2 instances: the 4 step titles in 'How it works' and the 8 integration titles both jumped from <h2> straight to <h4>.
machine_findings_fixed.fix: Retagged both sets of item titles from <h4> to <h3> (with a scoped CSS override so their visual size stays the smaller 23px step, independent of the tag) — restores a clean h1→h2→h3 outline everywhere on the page.

machine_findings_fixed.finding: taste-lint tap-target-undersized (warning): the mobile hamburger menu-toggle button was icon-only with no explicit height/padding evidence.
machine_findings_fixed.fix: Removed the hamburger button entirely rather than papering over the warning — it had no wired-up mobile menu behind it, so keeping it would have shipped a non-functional control (a real UX bug the linter doesn't check for). Mobile nav now shows wordmark + primary CTA only; the secondary nav CTA and link list hide under 640px, which is honest since there was no drawer to reveal them.

non_machine_findings_fixed.finding: Manually computed WCAG contrast ratios for every text/background pair (the linters have no contrast checker). --text-tertiary at #6f7179 measured 4.04:1 on the page background and 3.81:1 on card surfaces — both below the 4.5:1 AA floor for normal-weight text — even though it passed every automated gate.
non_machine_findings_fixed.fix: Raised --text-tertiary to #8b8d94 (5.94:1 on page background, 5.60:1 on card surfaces), re-verified every other text color pair by hand (primary 17.4:1, secondary 8.3:1, accent-on-ink 9.9:1+, teal 13.3:1), re-ran all four gates to confirm no regression.

non_machine_findings_fixed.finding: Rendered the page and noticed the GitHub Actions and GitLab CI integration cards used the identical hand-authored glyph — two different products reading as one lazy icon.
non_machine_findings_fixed.fix: Gave GitHub Actions a distinct workflow/play glyph and GitLab CI a distinct branch/fork glyph, keeping the same stroke weight and grammar as the other 6 icons (one family, one weight, still holds).

rubric_axis_self_scores.layout: 8 — asymmetric hero with a right-bled diagram continued visually in the next section; stepper, dense catalogue, and offset 3-column principles band are three distinct composition models, not a repeated card grid.
rubric_axis_self_scores.typography: 8 — single 1.333 ratio scale referenced entirely via CSS custom properties (never a hand-picked literal), roman display only, tight tracking on the display size, open body leading.
rubric_axis_self_scores.spacing: 8 — one 8px base unit throughout; deliberately dense inside the terminal specimen and integrations catalogue against an airy marketing rhythm elsewhere, matching the declared density-by-zone strategy.
rubric_axis_self_scores.motion: 7 — restrained, directional (ease-out entrances, no linear/bounce), staggered reveal, full prefers-reduced-motion fallback; kept intentionally modest for a technical audience rather than pushed to a 9.
rubric_axis_self_scores.iconography: 7 — one hand-authored line-icon family at a uniform 1.5px stroke throughout (declared, documented deviation from the literal Phosphor package since this is a single offline file with no build step); each icon is now distinct per product.
rubric_axis_self_scores.depth_surface: 8 — a named 4-step elevation ramp, background-tinted shadows (never pure black), white low-alpha hairlines on the dark surface (the correct direction, verified against mode-invisible-surface), no glass except the scroll-triggered nav tint.
